_catatan: Naskah explainer coderoach-os, diturunkan dari content/buklet.js (disetujui Farrez 9 Nov 2026).

gaya.id: Bacakan sebagai narator film dokumenter yang tenang, hangat, dan yakin, seperti video explainer sejarah. Tempo sedang, beri jeda panjang di antara paragraf.
gaya.en: Read as a calm, warm, confident documentary narrator, like a history explainer video. Medium pace, with a long pause between paragraphs.

teks.id: Coderoach adalah studio produk digital dengan dua model pendapatan: proyek harga tetap dan retainer bulanan.
teks.en: Coderoach is a digital product studio with two income models: fixed-price projects and monthly retainers.

teks.id: Tiap minggu pertanyaannya sama. Proyek mana yang untung setelah jam dihitung? Siapa belum bayar? Kas aman tiga bulan ke depan?
teks.en: Every week, the same questions. Which projects profit once hours count? Who hasn't paid? Is cash safe for three months?

teks.id: Tim mengisi jam per proyek tiap minggu, lalu margin tiap proyek dihitung dari situ. Riwayat GitHub ikut dicocokkan dengan jam tercatat.
teks.en: The team logs hours per project each week, and every project's margin is calculated from it. GitHub history is matched against the logged hours.

teks.id: Penawaran jadi proyek, fase selesai jadi termin siap tagih, invoice terbit, lalu semuanya masuk jurnal dan laporan kas.
teks.en: A quote becomes a project, a finished phase becomes a billable milestone, an invoice goes out, and everything lands in the books and cash reports.

teks.id: Dipakai internal dengan data sungguhan. Per 5 November 2026 ada 179 berkas tes dan lebih dari 80 catatan keputusan.
teks.en: Used internally with real data. As of 5 November 2026: 179 test files and more than 80 decision records.
